cases.sentence: Кто это идет из Идома в одеяниях красного цвета? Кто это, одетый так великолепно, выступающий в величии своей ___?
cases.explain: The preposition в with величии (in the greatness) requires the genitive case for the following noun силы.

cases.sentence: Я топтал в давильне один, никого из _____ со мною не было.
cases.explain: The preposition из (from) governs the genitive case.

cases.sentence: Я топтал их в своем ______, попирал их в негодовании.
cases.explain: The preposition в (in) with a location or state of being requires the prepositional case.

cases.sentence: День возмездия был в моем _______, и настал год моего искупительного труда.
cases.explain: The preposition в (in) requires the prepositional case for the location сердце.

cases.sentence: Тогда рука моя принесла мне ________, и негодование мое меня поддержало.
cases.explain: Принесла (brought) is a transitive verb requiring the accusative case for its direct object.

cases.sentence: Во всех их горестях он горевал вместе с ними, и _____ его присутствия спасал их.
cases.explain: The noun is the subject of спасал (saved), so it requires the nominative case.

cases.sentence: Но они восстали и огорчили святого _______ его, и он стал им врагом.
cases.explain: Огорчили (grieved) is a transitive verb requiring the accusative case, and for animate nouns, this matches the genitive form.

cases.sentence: Тогда ______ его вспомнил древние дни, дни Моисея.
cases.explain: The noun is the subject of вспомнил (remembered), requiring the nominative case.

reading.ru: Это я, возвещающий оправдание, имеющий силу спасать.
reading.question: What does the speaker claim to be able to do?
options: Proclaim righteousness and have the power to save
Judge the nations and execute vengeance
Control the weather and create lightning
reading.correct: Proclaim righteousness and have the power to save
reading.explain: The speaker says 'Это я, возвещающий оправдание, имеющий силу спасать' — 'It is I who proclaim righteousness and have power to save.'

reading.ru: Я посмотрел, но помощника не было. Был потрясен, что никто не помог.
reading.question: What does the speaker notice when he looks around?
options: No helper is present, and he is appalled that no one helped
Many people have gathered to assist him
His enemies are ready to attack
His allies are marching toward him
reading.correct: No helper is present, and he is appalled that no one helped
reading.explain: The text states 'Я посмотрел, но помощника не было. Был потрясен, что никто не помог' — 'I looked, but there was no helper. I was appalled that no one helped.'

reading.ru: Вспомню о милостях Господних, о славных Господних делах, обо всем, что Он для нас совершил.
reading.question: What does the speaker intend to recall?
options: The mercies of the Lord, his glorious deeds, and all he has done for us
The sins of the people and their rebellion
The greatness of Moses and the prophets
reading.correct: The mercies of the Lord, his glorious deeds, and all he has done for us
reading.explain: The passage says 'Вспомню о милостях Господних, о славных Господних делах' — 'I will recall the mercies of the Lord, his glorious deeds.'

reading.ru: Он сказал, 'Несомненно, они мой народ, сыновья, которые мне не солгут', и стал их спасителем.
reading.question: How does God regard the people, and what does he become for them?
options: They are his people and children, and he becomes their savior
They are his enemies, and he becomes their judge
They are strangers, and he sends them into exile
They are servants, and he tests them
reading.correct: They are his people and children, and he becomes their savior
reading.explain: The text says God called them his people and sons who would not lie, and 'стал их спасителем' — he became their savior.

reading.ru: По любви своей и милости он их искупил, поднял их и носил во все древние дни.
reading.question: How did God treat his people throughout the ancient days?
options: He redeemed them through his love and compassion, lifted them up, and carried them
He punished them for their disobedience
He ignored them and forgot their prayers
He led them astray and caused them to stumble
reading.correct: He redeemed them through his love and compassion, lifted them up, and carried them
reading.explain: The passage says 'По любви своей и милости он их искупил, поднял их и носил' — 'Through his love and compassion he redeemed them, lifted them up, and carried them.'

reading.ru: Где твои ревность и мощь, твои сострадания и милость от нас удалились?
reading.question: What is the people asking God in this verse?
options: Where are his zeal, power, compassion, and mercy, which seem to have withdrawn from them?
Why does he continue to bless them with all things?
When will he make them the richest nation?
How can they become worthy of his favor?
reading.correct: Where are his zeal, power, compassion, and mercy, which seem to have withdrawn from them?
reading.explain: The verse asks 'Где твои ревность и мощь... от нас удалились?' — 'Where are your zeal and might... withdrawn from us?'
